login.subtitle: Secure sign-in for your memory graph and studio sessions.

afterLogin.title: What opens up after login
afterLogin.body: You are about to enter a guided learning studio: a living memory graph, rehearsal rituals, and AI sessions that feel more like a performance than a dashboard. Every page after this is designed to remember context and keep your momentum.

dashboard.subtitle: Ready to master your concepts today?

demo.name: Demo Scholar
demo.title: Demo workspace
demo.body: You can explore flows and save drafts locally. Syncing and personalized insights unlock after sign in.

focus.title: Focus Area Detected
focus.body: You seem to be struggling with <topic>Recursion</topic> based on your last chat. Recommended: 15 min review.

session.lede: This is your live cockpit: a memory graph that evolves with every session, rehearsal rituals that adapt to your cadence, and a timeline that keeps your progress easy to revisit.

hero.lede: Ilmora is an ethical cognitive engine that feels like a live performance: adaptive, intimate, and improvisational. Build knowledge constellations, rehearse skills, and weave a memory map that remembers your story.

heroCard.title: Midnight Knowledge
heroCard.body: The assistant harmonizes your study beats into a living memory graph. No lost context, no cold starts.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.headline: Every discipline, one studio.
subjects.body: Math, physics, chemistry, biology, calculus, statistics, linear algebra, discrete math, CS, programming, economics, finance, business, history, literature, languages, design, music, medicine, engineering, law, and more.

items.one: Adaptive study plans, tuned per subject and pace.
items.two: Concept graph expansion with memory-safe summarization.
items.three: Exam rehearsal mode with timed recall and Socratic prompts.
items.five: Cross-topic synthesis to connect ideas across disciplines.

memory.title: Memory Graph
memory.body: A living map of concepts, notes, and goals that grows with every session.

ethics.title: Ethical AI
ethics.body: Grounded responses, privacy-respecting, transparent control over what is stored.

practice.title: Layered Practice
practice.body: Drills, reflections, and immersive tasks that sync across devices.

offline.title: Offline-first
offline.body: Keep studying even without signal. Syncs elegantly when you return.

experience.title: The Experience
experience.headline: Remember like a musician.
experience.body: Ilmora orchestrates your study ritual into a performance. Each note you take becomes a reusable motif in your knowledge graph.

one.text: "Turn my notes into a practice flow."
one.label: Studio prompt

install.title: Install everywhere
install.body: Ilmora is PWA-ready. Pin it to your desktop or phone like a native app and keep your momentum offline.

ritual.title: Your custom ritual
ritual.body: Switch between light and dark, adjust your focus ambience, and tailor the rhythm to match your study flow.

credits.title: Credits
credits.headline: Crafted with
credits.stack: Next.js, FastAPI, Firebase, Postgres + pgvector, Framer Motion and a lot of late-night jazz.
